title: Limit Off
description: A Fabric utility mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that allows server operators and singleplayer users to easily bypass vanilla block limits on-the-fly using simple, toggleable commands.
body:
## Features
- **Unlimited `/fill` Command**: Removes the vanilla 32,768 block volume limit for the `/fill` command, allowing you to fill massive areas at once.
- **Extended Piston Push Limit**: Raises the maximum number of blocks a piston can push from the vanilla 12 blocks up to a massive 300 blocks.
- **In-Game Toggles**: Both features can be toggled on and off dynamically in-game without needing to restart the server or reload the world.
- **Universal Compatibility**: Works seamlessly on both dedicated servers and singleplayer worlds. It only needs to be installed on the server-side to function!

## Commands
*Note: You must have OP permission level 2 or higher (or cheats enabled in singleplayer) to use these commands.*

- `/limitoff` - Displays the usage help message.
- `/limitoff fill` - Toggles the `/fill` command block limit on or off. Feedback is provided in chat so you know the current state.
- `/limitoff piston` - Toggles the piston push limit (between 12 and 300 blocks). Feedback is provided in chat.
